'''8K6''' was a [[Science droid/Legends|science droid]] in the service of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]]. He was aboard the [[Harbinger (Sith dreadnaught)|''Harbinger'']] when [[Phaegon III]]'s [[Moon/Legends|moon]] was stripped, and perished when the bridge on the ''Harbinger'' was destroyed.
